meta.rule: A node is attributed to a Canary Wharf entity (scope "branch") only when its postcode equals the entity's or its geo is within 300 m of the building (confidence high), it has no address and the page is the branch's own page: a store_url field, a store-finder result or a URL that names the place (medium), or its postcode is another E14/E20 postcode with any geo within 1.5 km (low: may be a sibling branch). A node with no address on a general page is scope "chain" when the entity is a chain branch (chain-wide facts, not branch facts), else "organisation" (the organisation's own site, which may be its only place). Nodes with an address or position elsewhere are not attributed (counted as elsewhere).
